_about: Public-domain John Kettlewell (1653-1695), Vicar of Coleshill, deprived nonjuror and devotional writer, for the Word Hoard: A Compleat Collection of his Works (London, 1719, two folio volumes) and the 1681 first edition of The Measures of Christian Obedience, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

kettlewell-works-1719-1: [Works] A compleat collection of the Works of the Reverend and learned John Kettlewell, ... In two volumes. The several treatises printed from copies revis'd and improv'd by the author, a little before his death. ... To which is prefix'd, the life of the author. ... With an appendix of several original papers.  1719: Vol 1, vol. 1 (catalogued 1719)
kettlewell-works-1719-2: [Works] A compleat collection of the Works of the Reverend and learned John Kettlewell, ... In two volumes. kettlewell-measures-1681: The measures of Christian obedience : or, A discourse shewing what obedience is indispensably necessary to a regenerate state, and what defects are consistent with it; for the promotion of piety, and the peace of troubled consciences (London : Printed by J. Macock, for Robert Kettlewell, 1681)

_alternates.kettlewell-copies: Separate printings, 1683-1737, of the Help and Exhortation to Worthy Communicating, the Practical Believer, Christian Prudence, Christian Communion, Death Made Comfortable, the Companion for the Penitent and Five Discourses, all in the Works

_excluded.kettlewell-other: Books by Samuel Kettlewell (Thomas a Kempis and the Brothers of Common Life, 1882; the authorship of the De Imitatione, 1877; Three Venerable Ladies, 1874) and other later Kettlewells
